brief.en: Flying shooters that shoot peas at the enemy at a higher speed
brief.zh: 更快地向僵尸发射豌豆，能在空中飞行

description.en: Skyshooters shoot peas at attacking zombies. They can be planted in the sky.
description.zh: 飞行射手以更快的速度在空中向僵尸发射豌豆。

chat.en: The youngest Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license. Also the only Peashooter ever to earn a pilot's license.
chat.zh: 在豌豆射手中，他是最年轻就考得飞机驾驶证的那一位，也是唯一的一位。

text.en: could be planted in the sky
